rules.name: Core Curriculum
rules.desc:
Students must enroll in CSRE 100 or ASNAMST 100 before a declaration is approved for the minor in Asian American Studies.
Please note that students are encouraged to begin the declaration process as soon as possible. The minor will be tagged as “pending” until CCSRE confirms enrollment in one of the gateway courses.

rules.name: Asian American Studies Electives (21 units)

limits.label: DAAAS, CHILATST, CSRE, JEWISHST and NATIVEAM courses

rules.desc:
Asian American Studies minors must complete the remaining units of their 30-unit minimum with elective coursework in Asian American Studies, with the exception below.
Asian American Studies minors may count up to 5 units of Department of African and African American Studies (DAAAS), Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies (CHILATST), Comparative Studies in Race and Ethnicity (CSRE), Jewish Studies (JEWISHST), or Native American Studies (NATIVEAM) courses toward their degree in Asian American Studies.

grading: A minimum grade of C- is required for a student to count a class towards the Core Curriculum, including the Gateway and Minor Core. Additional units toward the minor require a passing grade of D- or above. Student may count 1 class with Satisfactory/No Credit (SNC) grading basis toward Additional Units.
policies: No more than 5 units of petitioned courses that are not listed under CCSRE or cross-listed with CCSRE may be applied to electives in the Asian American Studies minor. Students who wish to petition a course must fill out and submit a course petition form for the CCSRE Academic Programs team to review within one month of completing their annual degree audit meeting with the CCSRE Student Services Officer.
transferPolicy: Up to ten units of external credit may be applied toward elective coursework in the minor.
reviewNotes: The audit checks CSRE 100 and ASNAMST 100, letter graded with a C- or better, and 21 units of electives in ASNAMST, with at most 5 units of AFRICAAM, CHILATST, CSRE, JEWISHST or NATIVEAM courses, toward the 30 units the minor needs. Petitioned courses (at most 5 units) and external credit (at most 10 units) are moved in by hand. Left: only one elective may be taken S/NC, which the audit does not limit.
